Dear Mrs Okafor,

Thank you for confirming the Year 7 residential with us again this year. I've set out below where everything stands for the trip to Blackmoss on Wednesday 10 March, so that your office and our planners are looking at the same arrangements.

Pick-up. Both vehicles will be at the main gate on Holmbrook Lane from 07:45 for an 08:15 departure. Our drivers will need the coach bay kept clear; your site manager has kindly agreed to cone it off the evening before. Luggage goes in the lockers underneath; we ask for one bag per pupil and no more than 15 kg.

Route. We'll take the A62 and the M62 as far as junction 22, then the moorland road. The drivers stop once, at the services, for twenty minutes. Arrival at Blackmoss is planned for 10:30. The return on Friday 12 March leaves the centre at 14:00 and is back at school for about 16:00.

Vehicles. Both coaches are as on your booking confirmation.

Drivers' hours. Our drivers stay at the centre overnight in the staff block, so the times above are fixed and cannot be brought forward.

Payment. Our invoice will follow after the trip, at the price agreed in October, as usual.

If anything changes on your side, especially numbers, please let me know by the end of February.

Kind regards,
Malcolm Firth
Bookings, Pennine Ways Coaches
